# M-01 — Ledger CLI

## Acceptance criteria

| ID | Given / When / Then | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| AC-01-01 | Given two readings for one meter, when the tool runs, then the ledger has one day with the difference. | R-001 |
| AC-01-02 | Given a conflicting duplicate, when the tool runs, then it exits nonzero and the old ledger is unchanged. | R-002 |
| AC-01-03 | Given valid input, when the tool runs, then counts appear on stderr. | R-003 |
